These substances are all known to interact with the Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B1, indicating a possible pathway through which Solacongestidine may exert its effects. The consistent scores across the three paths, all set at 0.565, suggest a moderate level of confidence in the observed relationships. The mechanisms involve the compound's interaction with GR-ST, which in turn influences the activity of the transporter, potentially affecting anion transport processes. While the evidence is robust, the exact nature of Solacongestidine's interaction with the transporter remains to be fully elucidated, and further experimental validation would be necessary to confirm the proposed relationship.
